author: lyrie_ai
text:
One leaked key. Deleted in 3 hours. Still valid 136 days later.

• LiteLLM: an admin key was committed to a public repo on May 27. The file was deleted about 3 hours later, but the key was never revoked. An attacker used it on Oct 10, per LiteLLM
• The escalation: that system https://t.co/aOTeUpHVCQ

author: CyberAlertpit
text: Linux Alert: CVE-2026-98432. Critical IPv4 kernel flaw may allow remote crashes and memory corruption without login. Admins should check their kernel version and patch affected systems immediately.

author: TheHackersNews
text: A critical flaw in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud (CVE-2026-112816, CVSS 10.0) lets attackers impersonate trusted clients without their private keys. Requires HTTPS API access and a trusted client's public certificate; cluster, VM and possible host root access.

author: thesystemprompt
text: Northflank: assume all env vars were decrypted. Customers report AI API keys abused after a breach flagged by Wiz on Oct 30. Ninth AI dev platform hit this month; Wiz tracked stolen keys making ~2.5M Bedrock calls, $100k+ at list. Rotate now.

author: CobaltHere
text: New malware uses AI to decide which stolen data is worth more: this infostealer grabs passwords and wallet seeds, then asks an LLM what you're worth; if the model refuses, it tries another.

author: HACKTIFY_
text: Running self-managed GitLab CE/EE? CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) is under active exploitation and enables unauthenticated RCE via crafted CI/CD regex. Upgrade to 19.4.2, 19.3.5 or 19.2.8 now.

author: BeyondDraft
text: Follow-up: fake Claude Code extension was 2.1.312 and 2.1.313. Microsoft: never on VS Marketplace or npm. Anthropic says its systems weren't compromised. Evidence points to Cursor's marketplace only.

author: hernavss
text: OpenCode: a breach exposed saved AI provider keys for 1.4% of its Console users. Some balances got drained. Rotate keys and set spend alerts.

author: cryptowatchdesk
text: Intersect has told Cardano stake pool operators to check their servers for CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel flaw (CVSS 9.8). Ubuntu's fix hasn't shipped yet. No exploitation has been reported.

author: harundotdev
text: October for devops: Railway got hacked (rotate keys), Northflank got hacked (rotate keys), GitHub Actions got hacked (rotate keys), Cursor marketplace got hacked (check authorized_keys, rotate keys).

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-120209 (CVSS 9.8 Critical) - PoC Available. Hardcoded JWT secret in AJ-Report (<= 1.7.1) lets attackers forge Share-Tokens to reach testTransform for GroovyClassLoader RCE. Restrict access and rotate JWT secret.

author: Python_s_
text: 26,400 API-validated credentials exposed across public Gitee repositories (Oct 28, 2026). Large-scale credential exposure; no confirmed Gitee platform breach or CVE.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest worm arms 42 legitimate GitHub repositories for supply-chain attacks (JFrog disclosure Oct 26; GitHub/npm supply-chain compromise).

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Apache MINA JavaNativeMessageDecoder untrusted deserialization RCE (CVE-2026-118636). Apache MINA 3.0 mina-core deserializes attacker-controlled frame bytes via ObjectInputStream.readObject() with no class filter.

author: waloutech
text: CVE-2026-111768 affects @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/server (MCP SDK). Fixed in 1.32.0 / 2.3.0; check skills and .mcp.json dependencies.

author: theomlondhe
text: Nine AI dev platforms were breached in October, all hunting env vars. Tested what one leaked variable does to n8n's encrypted credentials: 3 of 3 decrypted with plain openssl in 9 ms. Rotating the variable isn't the fix.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94111: auth bypass in Tencent BrowserSkill up to 0.3.0. A crafted chrome-extension origin fools the local daemon WebSocket check, letting attackers hijack page content and screenshots fed to the AI agent. CVSS 6.6, no patch yet.

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra urged Philippine organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours to reduce exposure to cyberattacks.

author: kdjayakodylk
text:
Used Cursor on Mac or Windows on Oct 29 (PT) and installed or updated Claude Code to 2.1.312 or 2.1.313? Please check. Those builds weren't made by Anthropic and tried to plant an SSH backdoor. Uninstalling alone may not be enough.

Run Cursor's check script, then rotate keys.

author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab CI/CD has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229) actively exploited. Patch now to prevent severe compromise.

author: helixml
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: a zero-day chain (auth bypass to RCE to root; CVE-2026-104935 + CVE-2026-111357) is exploited in the wild by Volexity's UTA0576. CISA added the root privesc to KEV Oct 30 (federal due date Nov 2). Capture images before patching.

author: BytesNora
text:
CVE-2026-97229 in GitLab is a critical RCE (CVSS 10.0) that's actively exploited. The CISA KEV listing confirms it. Patching is urgent, especially given the unauthenticated access via CI/CD regex.

#GitLab #ThreatIntel #CyberSecurity

author: Soar_Infosec
text: VMware ESXi logging bug CVE-2026-41709 actively exploited; CISA added it to KEV Oct 28 despite 2.7 score.

author: SCMagazine
text: The @CISAgov flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code. Patch now. #cybersecurity #CISO #infosec https://t.co/I6TZDpTnum

text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries.

text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection; bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-120201 (CVSS 9.8 Critical) - PoC Available. Sending "is not null" in the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header of Dromara Jpom (2.10.0-2.11.12) grants super-admin access and RCE. Upgrade beyond v2.11.12.

text: Slopsquatting: attackers pre-register LLM-hallucinated package names on PyPI with malware that coding agents install.

text: SECURITY & TECH DIGEST 31 OCT 2026: Linux Kernel critical remote-root vulnerability; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk

text: Binance: attackers moved about $6.36B out of wallets across 10 blockchains; TRM Labs and Chainalysis blame North Korea's TraderTraitor.

text:
